evidence: Modifies Tor control integration logic in src/torcontrol.cpp and src/torcontrol.h.
rationale: It fixes an unconditional log spam regression from v32 that printed roughly 18 warning lines per hour to debug.log on default nodes without Tor. While primarily a logging refinement, it resolves active user friction documented in #36691 without compromising Tor diagnostics when Tor is explicitly enabled.
